info.title: twitter (WorkflowBench simulated)
info.description: X (Twitter) API v2. All requests require Authorization: Bearer {token}. OAuth 2.0 Bearer Token for app-only auth; OAuth 1.0a or OAuth 2.0 PKCE for user-context endpoints (likes, follows, post tweet).

post.summary: Publish a new tweet. To reply to an existing tweet, supply the target tweet ID via reply.in_reply_to_tweet_id.
post.description: Publish a new tweet. To reply to an existing tweet, supply the target tweet ID via reply.in_reply_to_tweet_id.

get.summary: Find tweets published within the past 7 days. Accepts full-text search operators such as from:user, #hashtag, and others
get.description: Find tweets published within the past 7 days. Accepts full-text search operators such as from:user, #hashtag, and others.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Search expression up to 512 characters. Supports operators: from:, to:, #hashtag, @mention, is:retweet, lang:.

parameters.name: max_results
parameters.description: Number of results to return per page (range 10â€“100, default 10).

parameters.name: tweet.fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of tweet fields to include: id,text,author_id,created_at,public_metrics,conversation_id.

parameters.name: expansions
parameters.description: Related objects to expand alongside the results, e.g. 'author_id'.

parameters.name: next_token
parameters.description: Cursor token from the previous page of results, used for pagination.

200.description: {data: [{id, text, author_id, created_at, public_metrics}], meta: {newest_id, oldest_id, result_count, next_token}}

get.summary: Retrieve a user's profile by their @username (omit the @). Returns id, name, username, and any additionally requested fi
get.description: Retrieve a user's profile by their @username (omit the @). Returns id, name, username, and any additionally requested fields.

parameters.name: username
parameters.description: The target user's handle, without the @ prefix.

200.description: {data: {id, name, username, description, public_metrics, verified, created_at}}

post.summary: Follow another user on behalf of an authenticated account. Requires user-context OAuth credentials.
post.description: Follow another user on behalf of an authenticated account. Requires user-context OAuth credentials.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The user ID of the authenticated account performing the follow.

requestBody.description: Body: {target_user_id (required, string) â€” the ID of the user to follow}

post.summary: Like a tweet on behalf of an authenticated user. Requires user-context OAuth credentials.
post.description: Like a tweet on behalf of an authenticated user. Requires user-context OAuth credentials.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The user ID of the authenticated account performing the like.

requestBody.description: Body: {tweet_id (required, string) â€” the ID of the tweet to like}

get.summary: Returns the profile of the currently authenticated user. Useful for retrieving your own account ID, username, and displa
get.description: Returns the profile of the currently authenticated user. Useful for retrieving your own account ID, username, and display name.

parameters.name: user.fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of user fields to include in the response.

200.description: {data: {id, name, username, description, public_metrics, verified, created_at}}

text.description: The content of the tweet (maximum 280 characters).

name.description: The user's display name shown on their profile.

username.description: The user's handle, without the @ symbol.
